clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says J.D. Rockefeller's secret started before he had any money at all.

In the 1800s, Rockefeller's first job paid him $1.50 a week. He gave 10% away anyway - plus more on top as an offering.

He wasn't rich yet. He was just starting the habit he'd keep for the rest of his life.

Kevin says that one practice, done when he was broke, is why Rockefeller was eventually able to give away over $300 billion.

What would change if you gave before you felt like you could afford to?

#kevintrudeau #money #wealth #rockefeller #mindset #giving

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of the night he couldn't let go of cash in his own hand.

He was at a church seminar on success, and when the offering plate came around, something in him locked up. His fingers wouldn't open.

He says he could feel the fear, the attachment, fighting to keep the money in his fist.

Then he let go. And in that moment, he says, he felt the most freedom he'd ever experienced in his life.

Is it the money you're holding onto, or the fear of letting it go?

#kevintrudeau #money #mindset #freedom #success #motivation

clips.start_words: Here we go Are you ready
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau breaks down the exact formula for manifesting that Jesus used, word for word.

First: have faith - not hope, but complete certainty the universe works a certain way.

Second: say exactly what you want out loud. Not in your head. Out loud.

Third: believe it's already done, with zero doubt. And the part almost everyone skips - forgive everyone you're still holding something against, or it blocks the whole thing.

Which step have you been skipping?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #yourwishisyourcommand #lawofattraction #mindset #success
